scope: Independent offline transcript integrity and semantic checker. Sibling branch; does not import or modify receiver or V2 code. Conditional consistency with supplied trust anchor is its only positive result.

format_reference.relationship: Wire-format compatibility target only; not accepted, integrated or self-reviewed by this slice

implemented: Bounded canonical JSONL with duplicate/unknown key rejection
Exact externally supplied full-transcript SHA-256, count, tail, launch and challenge bindings
Independent prospective policy digest check, never receiving-derived membership
Strict ordinary attempt/result/cutoff/consumption grammar and per-attempt provenance-digest comparison
Rejection of truncation, substitution, reorder, failure, replayed IDs, hidden rows, rollback/refill and late events
anchor_contract: Caller must obtain anchor and expected bindings/policy from an independently authenticated, rollback-resistant receiver/witness channel. Supplying an anchor generated from the transcript defeats the trust boundary. This module deliberately provides no anchor generation API and reports anchor_authentication_established=false.
limits: No authentication of anchor, events, process, receiver or VM
No durable replay database or single-use consumption in this stateless offline checker
No filesystem or snapshot-of-live-path claims: transcript must be immutable bytes
No VM coverage, hidden-generator proof, prepared-worker evidence, full manifest, runtime admission or execution permit
No immutable deployment, kernel/storage qualification, signatures, external durable witness or reproducible derivative VM
All hidden families fail here because authenticated generator provenance substrate is absent; the adopted exception is unchanged
Successful checking proves consistency with trusted inputs only; it does not prove that those inputs are trusted
qualification: 35 synthetic non-corpus unittest methods plus binding/provenance subcases. Mutation fixtures re-anchor deliberately malformed grammar only to test semantic rejection, never to demonstrate authentication. Local attempt 1 passed; pinned CI separately recorded.
review_requested: Independent Reviewer B source and conditional evidence-checking review only. No self-adoption. Authentication, integration and admission remain downstream.
